name: sweep_reads
title: Sweep: friends of friends + name scans without an index
why: as in analytics: Chunked serves many friend lists and the unindexed name scan with few SEEKs ({ch_ops} ops against {dg_ops} for Split/Condensed) at the cost of whole-chunk bytes ({ch_bytes} against {dg_bytes}). Both reads want the same thing from their parts, so a mixed layout adds nothing; mixed per direction opens a middle point (knows is stored once per friendship, so a person's in- and out-lists differ).
